# Saral Forge

> Saral Forge is a Sydney software studio building websites, booking systems, apps, automation and cloud systems.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://saralforge.com/): Studio overview, example workflows and services
- [Services](https://saralforge.com/services.html): Websites, booking, automation, applications and cloud engineering
- [Work](https://saralforge.com/work.html): Illustrative example workflows, not client case studies
- [About](https://saralforge.com/about.html): Studio principles and approach
- [Start a project](https://saralforge.com/start.html): Preview-only project brief form

## Accuracy

The preview form does not transmit or store submitted information. Product information is not currently published.
